lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multi-row arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters along the lateral flank, showing an approximate horizontal alignment with variable inter-spot spacing between the pectoral fin and the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible grid-like pattern in the central region of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin; visible notch on the leading edge of the dorsal fin silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral region near the base of the pectoral fin.
